$schema: Tier pricing, weights and premium caps — single source of truth for what a USER is charged and what a request costs against their pool.
$canonical: tier-pricing.json at the monorepo ROOT. Edit only this file.
$sync: Mirrors are byte-identical GENERATED copies (each client bundles from its own root). After editing this file run: python3 scripts/sync_tier_pricing.py (use --check in CI). KlaatAI.Klaatu/tests/test_tier_pricing_contract.py asserts the gateway's _USER_COST_PER_MT / _UNIT_WEIGHTS_DEFAULT / cap tables match this file.
$note: Model/provider COST lives in model-pricing.json. This file is the sell side. Do not put provider cost here — clients must never display what we pay upstream.
$units: input/output are USD per 1 million tokens. weight is weighted request units consumed per user turn.

titan.label: Klaatu Titan
titan.note: Kimi K3 (2.5T). Never auto-routed — asked for by name or via the klaatu-titan alias.

$planPriceNote: Published monthly list price per seat. Lives here because the premium-cap budget is only meaningful against a price — the margin guard used to hardcode its own copy and drifted (it assumed Team $36 while we charge $30, so Team's ceilings were validated against revenue we don't collect). Must match Klaatu api/me_routes.py _PLAN_PRICE_USD and the subscription_plans table. Team is DELIBERATELY cheaper than Scale ($30 vs $32), so Team's caps must stay below Scale's.
$demotionNote: Edges the gateway enforces (api/quota.py _DEMOTION_MAP). `reason` demotes to the web `core` tier even for editor clients — a pre-existing quirk kept here so clients render what actually happens, not what would be tidier. `code` is never demoted: it has no enforced per-tier cap, the weighted pool governs it.
